The Quantity That a Profile Holds

Source: R/profile_class.R
profiled_quantity.Rd

The class of one label of a profile, which records what the label is and selects the graph that autoplot.StatmodProfile() draws for it. The five subclasses are

ProfiledCoefficient

a coefficient without a penalty, of a linear predictor or of the subformula of a term;

ProfiledPenalizedCoefficient

a coefficient under a quadratic penalty, of modelterms7::s(), modelterms7::random() or modelterms7::ridge();

ProfiledBreakpoint

the position of a break-point of modelterms7::seg() without a subformula, with the values of its covariate in covariate_values;

ProfiledHyperparameter

a hyperparameter that reml() or ml() estimates, on the scale of its link link;

ProfiledPathHyperparameter

the hyperparameter of a kinked penalty that a path chooses, on the scale of its link link.

Usage

profiled_quantity(
  label = character(0),
  estimate = integer(0),
  standard_error = integer(0)
)

ProfiledCoefficient(
  label = character(0),
  estimate = integer(0),
  standard_error = integer(0)
)

ProfiledPenalizedCoefficient(
  label = character(0),
  estimate = integer(0),
  standard_error = integer(0)
)

ProfiledBreakpoint(
  label = character(0),
  estimate = integer(0),
  standard_error = integer(0),
  covariate_values = integer(0),
  piecewise_constant = logical(0)
)

ProfiledHyperparameter(
  label = character(0),
  estimate = integer(0),
  standard_error = integer(0),
  link = NULL
)

ProfiledPathHyperparameter(
  label = character(0),
  estimate = integer(0),
  standard_error = integer(0),
  link = NULL,
  criterion_name = character(0),
  path_record = NULL
)

Arguments

label

The label in which.

estimate

The estimate on the scale of the profile.

standard_error

The standard error of the estimate on that scale, NA where it is not available.

covariate_values

The values of the covariate of a break-point.

piecewise_constant

Whether the profile of a break-point is constant between two consecutive values of the covariate, which is the case of the position of a sharp modelterms7::jump() or modelterms7::jseg().

link

The link of a hyperparameter, a linkfunctions7::link object.

criterion_name

The name of the criterion that chose the hyperparameter of a path ("BIC", "AIC" or "CV").

path_record

The points that the path scored, a data frame with the columns value (on the scale of the link), criterion and se (the standard error of a cross-validated criterion, NA otherwise).

Value

An object of the class.
